cards.name: Blood Rush
cards.description: Killing a bleeding enemy while Samurai is active grants +20% movement speed for 3 seconds. Refreshes without stacking. Also triggers on lethal Blood Detonation; ends on swap.

cards.name: Vacuum Reach
cards.description: +15% Iaijutsu vacuum reach per rank. Maximum 5 ranks: base 60 cm reaches 105 cm. Does not increase the slash hitbox.

cards.name: Cascade Power
cards.description: +20% Death Cascade attack damage per rank, including its crossing lanes and Endpoint Burst. Maximum 5 ranks. Cascaded attacks cannot cascade again.

cards.name: Dash Draw Power
cards.description: +20% Dash Draw attack damage per rank, including its crossing lanes and Endpoint Burst. Maximum 5 ranks. Does not increase normal or cascaded attack damage.

cards.name: Returning Blade
cards.description: Primary waves return to their launch point, hitting each enemy once more for 50% damage. Split waves do not return. Each wave keeps one split roll and one field opportunity across both passes.

cards.name: Slow Duration
cards.description: +1 second Crescent slow duration per rank. Maximum 5 ranks: base 5 seconds reaches 10 seconds. Unavailable with Sudden Eruption; owned ranks convert into Wave Damage.

cards.name: Arc Volley Chance
cards.description: +10 percentage points Arc Volley chance per rank. Maximum 5 ranks: base 15% reaches 65%.

cards.name: Wake Chance
cards.description: +5 percentage points damaging field chance per primary wave per rank. Maximum 5 ranks: base 15% reaches 40%. Split waves inherit their parent result; returning waves do not reroll.
